verdicts.reason: A and B look the same at this size. Both squeeze the whole poster into a tiny banner: the headline is stacked in four lines down the left edge, and the body copy and legal text are a few pixels tall, which makes them unreadable. The CTA is a tiny pill crammed under the body copy. The SOLSTICE logo, the dark brand header and the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow are gone. The legal text is the same size as the message, so the hierarchy is broken.
